full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white mixed-media image shows a young person's upward-tilted face dissolving into torn photographic and ink-like fragments on a nearly white ground. The head occupies the center-left, with the chin and long neck reaching toward the lower middle. The face is seen from a low angle, nose and lips prominent as it turns slightly to the viewer's right. One eye is half closed beneath irregular dark marks; the other is obscured by layered pieces across the brow and forehead. Short wavy hair and an exposed ear remain visible on the left side. Around the temple, several pale rectangular strips and darker charcoal blocks overlap like misaligned printed photographs. Some fragments extend horizontally toward the left, others rise above the forehead, and narrow vertical lines drop past the neck. The right side of the face stays relatively smooth and light, while the left hair and brow break into scratched texture, dark paint, and translucent gray smears. A pale garment or shoulder is barely indicated at the bottom, its edge fading into the white background. The figure has no visible props, and the open space at the right remains almost empty. Light is soft and broad from the front-left, revealing realistic volume on the cheek, nose, lips, and throat without hard cast shadows. The darkest values are concentrated in the fragmented hair and one side of the face, so the image seems to emerge from and disappear back into the blank surface. Fine grain and faint pencil-like lines sit over the photographic tones. There is no readable text within the collage. The overall composition is sparse and unsettling, using precise human features, broken rectangular layers, and a great deal of white space to convey a suspended, incomplete identity.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白混合媒介图像呈现一张年轻人的仰起面庞，在近白底面上消散成撕裂的摄影与墨迹般碎片。头部占据中央偏左，下巴与长颈延伸至下方中间。面部从低角度可见，鼻和唇突出，略向观者右侧转动。一只眼睛在不规则深痕下半闭，另一只被眉额上的层叠片块遮住。左侧仍可见短波浪发与露出的耳朵。太阳穴周围，几条浅色矩形带和更深的炭灰色块重叠，像错位的印刷照片。有些碎片水平伸向左侧，有些在额上升起，狭窄竖线落过颈部。面部右侧相对平滑浅淡，左侧头发和眉部则散成划痕肌理、深颜料与半透明灰色污痕。下方几乎只隐约画出浅色衣物或肩膀，边缘融入白色背景。人物没有可见道具，右侧开放空间近乎空白。光从左前方柔和而宽阔地照来，让面颊、鼻子、嘴唇和喉部具有写实体积，没有坚硬投影。最深明度聚于破碎头发和半张脸，使图像仿佛从空白表面浮现，又退回其中。摄影调子上覆有细颗粒与淡淡铅笔般线条。拼贴中没有可读文字。整体构图疏朗而不安，以精确的人类五官、破碎矩形层和大量白色空间，传达悬而未决、不完整的身份感。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome mixed-media treatment lets realistic tonal volume emerge from and dissolve into an almost white field. Photographic mid-grays sit beside charcoal-black ink, scratched lines, translucent smears, and misregistered rectangular fragments. Detail is concentrated in a small central zone; large surrounding areas remain blank and luminous. Hard cropped edges interrupt softer anatomical-looking gradients, producing a deliberate collision of precision and damage. Thin vertical runs and occasional horizontal strips create a loose cross-axis without forming a strict grid. Light is broad and soft, so depth comes from layered opacity and local value contrast rather than a dramatic cast shadow. Fine grain prevents the white and gray passages from feeling sterile. The overall effect is spare and psychologically charged, with fragmentation and negative space carrying the main visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 单色混合媒介处理让写实明度体积从近白色域中浮现，并重新消散。摄影式中灰与炭黑墨迹、刮线、透明污痕和错位矩形碎片相邻。细节集中在小小的中央区域，周围大片空间保持空白而发亮。硬朗裁切边缘打断更柔软的解剖般渐层，有意让精确与破损相撞。细竖向流痕和偶尔的水平条带形成松散十字轴，却没有变成严格方格。光宽阔柔软，深度来自叠层透明度和局部明度反差，而非戏剧性投影。细颗粒让白灰区域不至于无菌。整体效果疏朗而富于心理张力，碎裂与负空间承载主要视觉节奏。
theme_en: An upward-tilted face dissolving into grayscale collage fragments
theme_zh: 仰起的面庞消散成灰阶拼贴碎片
name: Januz Miralles
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
